snippet.title: Last Buzz - Official Gameplay Trailer #funnygaming #steam #indiegame #coopgaming #coop  #gameplay
snippet.description:
The Last Buzz demo is coming next week! Try the game with your friends and add it to your Steam Wishlist!

🛒 Add Last Buzz to your Steam Wishlist today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4927030/Last_Buzz/

Last Buzz is an upcoming online game for 2–6 players, featuring an asymmetric Humans vs. Flies showdown that combines hide-and-seek, survival, and teamwork.

Play as Flies: search for food, crawl across walls and ceilings, rescue your teammates, and try to survive until the end of the round.

Play as Humans: protect your home, set traps, and use sprays and various gadgets to catch all the flies!

🎮 Title: Last Buzz
🗓️ Demo Release: Next week
📅 Full Release: Coming Soon
👥 Players: 2–6 players
🖥️ Platform: PC (Steam)
🏢 Developers: Vincentnerv, Zabyvajko

If you love fun party games, stealth, and chaotic multiplayer with friends, be sure to add Last Buzz to your Steam Wishlist!
